title: Plural Nouns and Articles
module: Módulo 2 — Objetos, descrições e ações cotidianas
main_grammar: plural regular de substantivos e artigos.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Objects and people in your home” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Plural articles agree with plural nouns: os/as/uns/umas, usually with noun + s.
student.english_comparison: English articles do not mark plural gender; Portuguese articles do.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “The books are new.”?
Which sentence expresses “The houses are big.”?
Which sentence expresses “These are two books.”?
Which sentence expresses “Some friends are here.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: As duas mesas e quatro cadeiras estão na sala. Os livros são novos. As professoras estão na escola. Uns amigos estão aqui. As casas da rua são pequenas. Os alunos são brasileiros e os professores são americanos.
questions: As casas da rua são grandes ou pequenas?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Both article and noun signal plural.

examples.en: Some tables are in the room.

review.compare: o livro / os livros: one identified book versus several.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: Some tables are in the room.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: Some tables are in the room.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Uns amigos estão aqui. ________ dois livros.
As professoras são brasileiras. ________ amigos estão aqui.
Umas mesas estão na sala. ________ professoras são brasileiras.
Os livros são novos. ________ mesas estão na sala.
items.hint: Some tables are in the room.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Três livros e duas bolsas estão na casa. Os livros são novos. As bolsas são velhas. Uns alunos estão na sala. Umas professoras estão na escola. Os amigos são brasileiros. As alunas são americanas.
questions: As bolsas são novas ou velhas?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: Quantos livros estão na mesa?
questions.english: How many books are on the table?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “The books are new.”? A. As casas são grandes. B. Os livros são novos. C. Uns amigos estão aqui.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: B. Os livros são novos. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: ________ livros são novos. (The books are new.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: Os → Os livros são novos. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: São dois livros. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: The books are new. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Quatro cadeiras estão na sala. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Uns amigos estão aqui.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: As professoras são brasileiras. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Umas mesas estão na sala. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “The houses are big.”?
Which sentence expresses “These are two books.”?
Which sentence expresses “Some friends are here.”?
Which sentence expresses “The teachers are Brazilian.”?
Which sentence expresses “Some tables are in the room.”?

items.hint: Some tables are in the room.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Duas amigas estão em casa. Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa. Uns professores estão no trabalho. As casas perto da escola são bonitas. Os alunos estão na sala. Umas bolsas são brancas e outras são azuis.
questions: Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa ou na sala?
As casas perto da escola são bonitas?
Os professores estão em casa ou no trabalho?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 4–6 sentences on the topic “Objects and people in your home”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Quantos livros estão na mesa? / As casas são grandes? / Uns amigos estão aqui? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Keep final -s audible; regional realizations vary.

mini_reading.translation: The two tables and four chairs are in the room. The books are new. The teachers are at school. Some friends are here. The houses on the street are small. The students are Brazilian and the teachers are American.

answers.question: As casas da rua são grandes ou pequenas?
answers.answer: As casas da rua são pequenas.

oral_substitution_drill.cue: Some tables are in the room.

fill_in.full_sentence: Uns amigos estão aqui. São dois livros.
As professoras são brasileiras. Uns amigos estão aqui.
Umas mesas estão na sala. As professoras são brasileiras.
Os livros são novos. Umas mesas estão na sala.

reading_aloud.translation: Three books and two bags are in the house. The books are new. The bags are old. Some students are in the room. Some teachers are at school. The friends are Brazilian. The female students are American.

answers.question: As bolsas são novas ou velhas?

speaking_practice.question: Quantos livros estão na mesa?
speaking_practice.watch_for: os casa → as casas (Casa is feminine.) as livro → os livros (Livro is masculine.)

speaking_practice.question: As casas são grandes?
speaking_practice.watch_for: os casa → as casas (Casa is feminine.) as livro → os livros (Livro is masculine.)

speaking_practice.question: Uns amigos estão aqui?
speaking_practice.watch_for: os casa → as casas (Casa is feminine.) as livro → os livros (Livro is masculine.)

D_portuguese_to_english: Some tables are in the room.

E_reading.translation: Two female friends are at home. The books and magazines are on the table. Some teachers are at work. The houses near school are beautiful. The students are in the room. Some bags are white and others are blue.

answers.question: Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa ou na sala?
answers.answer: Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa.

answers.question: As casas perto da escola são bonitas?
answers.answer: Sim, as casas perto da escola são bonitas.

answers.question: Os professores estão em casa ou no trabalho?

F_written_production.model_text: Duas amigas estão em casa. Os livros e as revistas estão na mesa. Uns professores estão no trabalho. As casas perto da escola são bonitas. Os alunos estão na sala. Umas bolsas são brancas e outras são azuis.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
